GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 2 Lengths , tailed off last off poor start 15 Lengths 1000m, still mile off them getting to Middle Of Track soon after Straightening Up , really got going last 200m and made up many lengths but never close enough # got going late

Jumped Ok Settled back Off Mid-Field 10 Lengths . worked forward out 3 Wide No Cover approaching 600m, Took over near 400m, went for home on Straightening Up , Kept Going Soundly to score # good ride & win

Slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace until pushed to stay in touch @ 700m. Chasing 3 Wide @ 600m & struggling to make ground Four Wide @ 400m. Chasing Six Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Made ground Five Wide in last 200m. # Did enough 1st-up.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. RR initially failed to respond to his riding from the 600m, however he was satisfied with the manner the gelding finished off the race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths , tailed off last 15 Lengths 1000m, still out the back on corner, picked up last 200m and passed some tiring ones but never close # passed tiring ones
missed start 3 Lengths and sat back long last 11 Lengths 1000m, still a mile off them on fence Straightening Up , Made Some Ground but was never close # passed a couple
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: RR that the gelding failed to muster early speed despite  her efforts.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths , Not Bustled Clear last 14 Lengths 1000m, rider Headed for Outside rail but still out the back Straightening Up , passed a few in Straight but was never close enough # made some ground
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide rounding the home turn. Laid in under pressure in the  straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly Settled back Off Mid-Field 6 Lengths . Straightened Up out in Middle Of Track , laid in, only whacked away # didn't threaten

Slow Out 1 Lengths , Drifted Back 3rd last Two Wide 9 Lengths 1000m, peeled off heels to Middle Of Track Straightening Up but still well off them, he knuckled down last 200m and ran into eye catching second spot # ran into placing
Jumped Ok Settled Just Off Mid-Field 8 Lengths . was 4-5 Lengths off on Straightening Up , couldn't quicken just whacked away under hard riding # didn't threaten
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Settled 3rd last 8 Lengths . came Wide in Straight , failed to run on under hard riding # never came into it
Jumped Ok Ridden Along early then Took A Sit 3rd behind Leader 2l. held up on Turn , was in restricted room all the way down the Straight # margin unfair
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event. Raced  in restricted room between other runners over the concluding stages of  the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled back Off Mid-Field 8 Lengths . had Good Run Through field rounding home turn as they bunched right up & was almost on terms on entering Straight . whacked away to finish 4th # could do no better
